notes.title: Demon Turf Queen's Edition upgrade
notes.notes:
By royal decree, [i]Demon Turf [/i]has been upgraded to the [i]Queen's Edition[/i]!

What does this mean we hear you ask? It means we've packaged our previously standalone game [i]Demon Turf: Neon Splash[/i] with Demon Turf's DLC [i]Demon Turf: Tower[/i] and the [i]Level Editor[/i] into the ultimate package of demon-y goodness.

It gets better... Anyone who already purchased [i]Demon Turf[/i] before this update gets all these extra goodies for FREE!

So what are you waiting for? Dive into [i]Demon Turf[/i] and see where Beebz's antics take you :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/9936daf9fc21fb0c9d8da97c5b82646e5fee398c.gif[/img]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
 
[h3]Does this update come with any pricing changes?[/h3]
The upgrade to Queen's Edition increases the game's price from 25$ to 30$ for any future purchases as the game's content has nearly doubled since launch. This upgrade, and its new content, is free for anyone who has bought the game before today.

[h3]What if I bought Neon Splash before?[/h3]
Before today Demon Turf and Neon Splash were sold separately as stand-alone titles. The Queen's Edition combines both games into one. If you are buying Demon Turf Queen's Edition, this means you do not need to buy Neon Splash separately. If you already have Neon Splash in your Steam library you can purchase the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325900/Demon_Turf_Queens_Edition/]Queen's Edition[/url] for 17% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325900/Demon_Turf_Queens_Edition/

[h3]What if I already bought Demon Turf before?[/h3]
If you already own Demon Turf, you don't need to do anything. You'll also have access to Neon Splash from the launch window.

[h3]How do I access all of the new content?[/h3]
The game now has a fancy launcher allowing you to pick which game to play! Demon Turf, Demon Turf Neon Splash or Demon Turf Tower. Don't worry, this works seamlessly with any gamepad as well as on the Steam Deck!

[h3]Will the console versions get the same upgrade?[/h3]
Unfortunately not due to technical reasons. The level editor heavily relies on Steam's online services. Neon Splash & Tower are separate applications which one can't bundle in a launcher on consoles. We are happy to report, however, that the Neon Splash standalone version is also launching on EGS & GoG today in addition to being available on the Nintendo Switch already.

[h3]Are y'all working on a new game yet?[/h3]
Heck yes. It's huge, ambitious and BEAUTIFUL... Any Demon Turf fan will be unbelievably excited about where we're taking the Expressive Platformer genre next. It is, undoubtedly, the most excited I've ever been for one of our games and I can't wait to show it off more! BUT... We need more time in the kitchen and sincerely ask y'all to let us cook for a bit longer! <3

notes.title: Demon Turf Tower Patch 1.0.1!
notes.notes:
[b]We've just updated [u]Demon Turf Tower[/u] fixing some reported issues & slightly balancing some meta movement tech! [/b]

Check out the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Gliding out of a wall cling or cyclone now acts like gliding in the air giving you no recovery options. Only gliding from the ground allows you to jump out of it.
[*] Gliding from the ground no longer gives you the chance to do another glide in the air, whether the fairy is equipped or not.
[*] Dying in the Hub area after unlocking the checkpoint hex no longer soft locks the game.
[*] Cannons no longer have a chance of getting stuck in the horizontal rotation.
[*] Hookshotting near teleport doors no longer messes up the teleports.
[*] Teleport hookshotting out of vents no longer give you infinite jumps.
[*] Interacting with a door during a hookshot doesn't have the rare chance of locking your camera movement anymore.
[*] Community voted on keeping the fairy knockback momentum bug, but it is slightly nerfed to only give you one floor worth of height at best.
[*] Added a new sign to the first floor mentioning the importance of angling your camera forwards during jumps.
[*] You can no longer get stuck infinitely between the bouncer & wall in floor 22.
[*] Added missing knockback colliders to poles in floor 41.
[*] Music no longer "wobbles" in the end menu at the end of a run.
[/list]

notes.title: Demon Turf Tower OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=n5jPUQHu9n0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Tower in fear…
[/h3]Demon Turf Tower is out now! This free expansion issues a challenge to any confident climbers, be you a Demon Turf veteran or someone new to the world of Beebz. Join some familiar faces in a monolithic new place and pit yourself against your most gruelling test yet…


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/461e145e59471e51816078d71116155a97f04ac4.png[/img]

[h3]Laugh. Cry. Die. Repeat.
[/h3]
Intricately designed to pressure even the proudest of platformers, this DLC will be both a test of skill and mental endurance. Players must traverse the Jester’s troublesome tower reclaiming lost abilities, all within one life. As you progress through the various floors, new threats and obstacles will litter your path. You may have to change tactics on the way, but the tower stands unchanged upon each return, meaning you’ll climb ever so slightly higher with each attempt. Practice makes perfect!

50 floors of torture await vengeful demons, and we encourage players who haven’t explored the core experience to do so first. This will aid you in scaling the tower and help to familiarise you with the game. Whilst this isn’t essential, be warned. You will fall. A lot.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/34debb235cac91c89637c7af7b00f8a916861dbc.png[/img]

[h3]Time Your Tower Trip
[/h3]
Bested the tower? We don’t believe you. If by some miracle you do manage to ascend the tower and return unscathed, your time will be recorded and posted on a handy leaderboard. This means that even when you finally conquer the tower, the silent taunts of those quicker than you will pull you back in on your quest to be the best. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/12a40f145560766f19e5d7bdcca6e94857f1f7c3.png[/img]

[h3]Demonically Delicious Discount!
[/h3]
Still yet to jump into Demon Turf? Not to worry, we’ve got you sorted. Demon Turf is on its biggest discount yet at 50% off, what a way to celebrate the launch! 
There has never been a better time to dive into Demon Turf, we can’t wait to see (and hear) all your tears/screams/cries of frustration. See you out there, demons! 😈


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325900/Demon_Turf/

notes.title: Demon Turf Tower Launches March 6!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=n5jPUQHu9n0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Are You Turf Enough?
[/h3]

Demon Turf is back with a free expansion, not for the faint of heart. Beebz has been hexed by the wicked Jester, leaving her completely powerless. The Demon Queen must traverse to the top of the tower in the hopes of regaining her strength or fall to her demise. Think you’ve got what it takes to flawlessly jump, dodge and dash your way to the top?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/911e2068bdba00a021ca7f1de081345c0fbaf1b6.png[/img]

[h3]Take on the Treacherous Tower
[/h3]

Tower acts as the hard mode expansion for the game, challenging old and new players alike to an unforgiving task. Players will take control of an uncharacteristically vulnerable Beebz, and must make it to the top in one run. With 50 floors ahead of you and only one life to do it, we know this will push players both new and old to their limits. Jump and dash your way to the very top, but know that if you fall, it’s all over!

For those of you savvy enough to best the tower, the fun doesn’t stop there. Players will also be timed on their tower runs, meaning you can speedrun to your heart’s content and see how you stack up against other tower trawling demons on the leaderboard! With a limited set of abilities and one shot at restoring her former glory, can Beebz beat the Jester’s Tower?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/e88fce2aca467567cbf4964a82d0c829b3576857.png[/img]

[h3]Free(fall) for all demons!
[/h3]

For those of you who own Demon Turf, this will be a free expansion to the game. Yes, that's right, FREE. Players can expect an update at launch before they can start their ascents. Be sure to follow the Playtonic Games [url=https://twitter.com/PlaytonicGames]Twitter[/url] for any and all updates about the game, and we’ll see you in the tower March 6th!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/12a40f145560766f19e5d7bdcca6e94857f1f7c3.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcing Demon Turf: Tower Free DLC
notes.notes:
Did you think the Demon Queen wouldn't make another grand entrance?

Demon Turf is getting a roguelite-esque FREE DLC that'll challenge any seasoned platforming champ! Let's check out the trailer.

[previewyoutube=laUTy4QgCGY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What's Demon Turf: Tower all about?[/b]

You've been stripped of all your powers and there's only one way to regain them: Climb the Jester's impossibly high tower! Can you overcome all of the hazardous challenges and gain back your abilities, one by one? All it takes is one slip up and you'll have to start over...

You'll be sweating, you'll be swearing but with each attempt you'll climb just a bit higher... And just that much closer to beating this incredibly tough challenge! Good luck, fellow demon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/911e2068bdba00a021ca7f1de081345c0fbaf1b6.png[/img]

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Roguelite-lite-esque gameplay! That's a mouthful, what does that mean exactly you ask? You HAVE to beat the tower in one run but it is NOT randomized. And the higher you get, the more powers you'll permanently unlock to help you in your next climb!
[*] One huge level with no loading zones and full of new challenges, hazards and platforming goodness!
[*] Ability loadout! Pick & adjust how your unlocked powers work to best fit your playstyle!
[*] Any% leaderboard! It'll be tough to beat the tower, but even if you do, can you be the fastest at it?
[*] Each time you retry, you'll see where you died last! *Feel* your progress!
[*] A brand new story featuring characters new and old!
[*] Photo Mode, of course!
[*] Settings galore!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016781/bbed4ebb600ca5bf479f1cbb58ab9c66a587f0e5.png[/img]

The DLC doesn't have a release date just yet, but we're working hard to bring it to you soon. Keep checking our social channels for sneak peeks and more news :) 


Fabraz & Playtonic Friends

The Level Creator is exactly as it sounds, a tool that enables you to create your own levels within Demon Turf. You can play and share it with the rest of the Demon Turf community and try out levels other people have created too!

For the full run down and FAQs, please see the full Level Creator documentation here: https://demonturf.com/custom_level.html

notes.title: Demon Turf review: new Beebz on the block
notes.notes:
You'd think being 1000 years old would earn you some respect, but in Demon Turf, that means you're still a child. Admittedly, it makes for an intriguing premise in this tale of conquest and demonic shakedowns, but don't be fooled. While its core systems take inspiration from 3D platformers of the N64 era, Demon Turf isn’t another Banjo Kazooie successor like publisher Playtonic's Yooka-Laylee. You’ll find those familiar cliches, sure, but there’s something great about Fabraz’s latest effort that goes beyond its unique visuals.

Read more
